sents.zh: 这是人类一个古老的主题。

sents.t: You can find it in virtually every culture.
sents.zh: 几乎在每一种文化里都能找到它。

sents.t: In, uh, religion, folklore, superstition, and, now, in science.
sents.zh: 在宗教、民间传说、迷信里，而现在，也在科学里。

sents.t: The search for life elsewhere is remarkable in our age because this is the first time that we can actually do something besides speculation.
sents.zh: 在我们这个时代，寻找地球以外的生命之所以了不起，是因为这是我们第一次真正能做些什么，而不只是空想。

sents.t: We can send spacecraft to nearby planets.
sents.zh: 我们可以把探测器送到邻近的行星。

sents.t: We can use large radio telescopes to see if there is any message being sent to us lately.
sents.zh: 我们可以用大型射电望远镜，看看最近有没有人在给我们发消息。

sents.t: And it touches to the deepest of human concerns.
sents.zh: 它触及人类最深的关切。
